name: convo_v3_get_portfolio
description: v3: look up one client's portfolio from the mock API (HTTP task) and shape the answer. Standalone so v4 can expose it as a tool.

inputParameters.queryExpression: if (.resp | type) == "object" and .resp.statusCode == 200 and (.resp.body | type) == "object" then {found: (.resp.body.found == true), portfolio: .resp.body, error: null} else {found: false, portfolio: null, error: "portfolio service unavailable"} end
